subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the experimental one-Claw/one-new-agent core CLI and grouped-manifest contract as the base for the linked lifecycle stack?
rationale: The patch is a coherent read-only implementation, but choosing whether grouped agent packages, stable plan output, and their future ownership lifecycle belong in core is a durable product and compatibility decision that source review cannot make.

options.title: Keep the stack incubating
options.body: Leave this PR and its RFC-backed dependent lifecycle stack open until maintainers explicitly approve or narrow the permanent core contract.

options.title: Approve the experimental core boundary
options.body: Accept this read-only planner as the supported experimental base and review later mutation slices against the same owner and upgrade contract.

options.title: Redirect optional packaging outward
options.body: Narrow the proposal toward a plugin or ClawHub package surface if maintainers do not want grouped agent lifecycle ownership in core.

recommendation.title: Keep the stack incubating
recommendation.body: Leave this PR and its RFC-backed dependent lifecycle stack open until maintainers explicitly approve or narrow the permanent core contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review supplied the strongest concrete product and schema boundary guidance for this contract.
